resourceTitle: Durable Agents Need State Outside The Loop
subtitle: What demos skip when agents become production workflows

sections.heading: The demo version
sections.body: The agent plans a step, calls a tool, gets a result, and continues.

sections.heading: Approval can arrive later
sections.body: A workflow may need to pause, wait for a person, and continue hours or days later.

sections.heading: Why it matters
sections.body: If state lives only in memory, there is not much to inspect, resume, or retry safely.

sections.heading: Workshop
sections.body: Running Durable Agents in Production with Nicholas Lotz, June 16, 4:30-6:00 PM GMT+2.
